cards.finding: No set way to match beds

sheets.title: One team does both jobs
sheets.text: Discharges and admissions sit with the same team. You placed it nearer both at once, and your times said afternoon.

sheets.title: Admission time about 3½ hours
sheets.text: About 3½ hours on a good day, 5½ at worst. About an hour of it is paperwork. The rest is waiting.

sheets.title: No set way to match beds
sheets.text: Nothing matches tomorrow’s admissions against the beds due to free. The picture comes together as the day goes.

sheets.title: Dead bed time 4 to 5 hours
sheets.text: On every change of patient, up to 8 hours on bad days. About ₹1.5 to 2 crore a year.

sheets.title: No team ever sized
sheets.text: Nobody has worked out whether housekeeping, transport or the admissions desk keep up at the busiest times.
